[[File:Fanfar.jpg|thumb|250px|A fanfar]]

The '''fanfar''' was a [[Music/Legends|musical]] instrument commonly used in [[Jizz/Legends|jizz]]. Fanfars appeared to be reedy instruments with a mouthpiece, and the slots along the fanfar were known as [[Farra slot/Legends|farra slots]]. A notable fanfar player was [[Tedn Dahai/Legends|Tedn Dahai]] of the [[Figrin D'an and the Modal Nodes/Legends|Modal Nodes]].
